name: daftari
description: Memory you own: a markdown + Git vault on your disk that your agent searches before answering and writes back to, with replaced beliefs and open contradictions kept visible.

interface.shortDescription: Memory you own, as markdown files on your disk
interface.longDescription: Rent the brain. Own the memory. Daftari keeps what your agent learns as plain markdown in a local Git repo. Recency never decides what's true: replaced beliefs keep their history and open contradictions stay flagged. Runs locally; nothing leaves your machine.
defaultPrompt: Remember that we chose Postgres over DynamoDB, and why.
What have we already decided about pricing?
Is anything in my memory stale or contradicting itself?
